name: Issue028 native compatibility / insufficient-cost-valid-razor-rejected
notes: After actual Razor resolves above Dodge, attacker has priority during the continuing Reaction Step. Second Razor has a legal cost0 attack-action target, but no floating resources and no other pitchable Hand card; source cannot pay for itself. Reject without source movement or extra power. Dodge2 leaves5 damage, hero15. Only the first real Razor grants its hit ability; resolve that ability before the single Resolution AP refund and Close. UID5 and6 distinguish duplicate Razor copies.
